decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory that complements the trailer range and after-sales business, it is relatively easy to keep unless the firm is simplifying the assortment.
A box car trailer series fits the firm's core transport offering for broad customer groups and is likely to remain a key volume product.
The car transporter trailer is more specialized and therefore carries a higher portfolio-cleanup risk, but it still matches the firm's core competence in vehicle transport solutions.
A low-bed trailer series expands the professional-use range in a way that supports the firm's growth and product-broadening strategy.
High trailer covers are a natural add-on to existing trailers and help monetize the installed base, even if they are less central than complete trailer models.
A box car trailer series is closely aligned with the firm's mainstream market and is likely worth retaining as part of a broad, reliable catalog.
